blocking_gate: The prototype defines only default circuit conditions, not the runtime priority or filter behaviour. No controlled game capture has been run for this checkout: task 02 had no Factorio installation or disposable save available, so nothing was measured.
control_state: planned: input and output priority set explicitly per trial
expected_behavior: Priorities and filters restrict how a splitter distributes items. For an optimistic upper bound they must be relaxed explicitly, and the relaxation recorded, rather than modelled as a hard split. The actual behaviour is not established here.
notes: The pilot's 15 fast splitters carry no priority or filter fields in the blueprint, so the pilot needs the unfiltered case first.
observation_method: Planned (CAPTURE.md 4.9): repeat the splitter trial with each input and output priority combination, then with a filter set, counting each output per interval.

supplied_items.source: planned: infinity chest set to provide iron plates without limit

title: Input/output priority and filter behaviour
